Players Committee card image of [[Arica (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/arica.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
